headlines.headline: Suns, Mercury CEO Josh Bartelstein finalizing extension
headlines.description: Suns and Mercury CEO Josh Bartelstein is finalizing a new extension, owner Mat Ishbia told ESPN, cementing their partnership to shape the operations of both franchises.

headlines.headline: Sources: Rui Hachimura, Clippers agree to 2-year, $28M deal
headlines.description: Free agent forward Rui Hachimura has agreed to a two-year, $28 million deal with the LA Clippers, sources tell ESPN's Shams Charania.

headlines.headline: Sources: Warriors' Post signing offer sheet with Grizzlies
headlines.description: Restricted free agent Quinten Post is signing a three-year, $30 million contract offer sheet with the Grizzlies, league sources told ESPN's Shams Charania. The Warriors have until 11:59 p.m. ET on Tuesday to match or they will lose the third-year center.

headlines.headline: Anaheim Ducks re-sign Pavel Mintyukov to five-year contract
headlines.description: Restricted free agent defenseman Pavel Mintyukov, who has 17 goals and 52 assists over 204 games in his first three seasons, signed a five-year contract extension Sunday worth $36 million with the Anaheim Ducks, a source told ESPN's Greg Wyshynski.

headlines.headline: Stars forward Jason Robertson files for salary arbitration
headlines.description: Stars winger Jason Robertson, Dallas' leading scorer who declined a long-term contract with the Seattle Kraken in a potential sign-and-trade deal, filed for salary arbitration Sunday.

headlines.headline: Predators give newly acquired Mavrik Bourque six-year deal
headlines.description: The Nashville Predators signed center Mavrik Bourque, 24, to a six-year, $33 million contract Saturday, three days after acquiring the restricted free agent from the Dallas Stars following a season in which he posted 20 goals and 21 assists in 82 games.

headlines.headline: Chase Stillman signs one-year deal with Detroit Red Wings
headlines.description: Forward Chase Stillman, 23, a St. Louis native and 2021 first-round pick of the New Jersey Devils, secured a one-year, two-way contract with Detroit on Sunday, a deal that will be worth $850,000 at the NHL level should he make the Red Wings roster.
